extracted.name: Cabbage Curry
extracted.description: This cabbage curry with veggies, fresh coconut, coconut milk, and Indian curry powder makes a wonderful vegetarian curry or side dish.
instruction_lines: Place a large skillet or wok over high heat. Heat oil and butter until smoking. Add onion, carrot, and garlic; cook and stir until onion begins to soften, about 1 minute. Add cabbage, coconut, and curry powder; stir fry for 2 more minutes.
Reduce heat to medium-low; pour in coconut milk, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Cover, and cook to desired doneness. To serve, sprinkle with tomato, green onions, and cilantro.
